question: If x + 1/x = 2√10, where x > 1, then the value of (x³ - 1/x³) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = p, then x − 1/x = √(p² − 4).

Given p = 2√10, so x − 1/x = √(40 − 4) = √36 = 6.

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Substituting k = 6:

x³ − 1/x³ = 6³ + 3 × 6 = 216 + 18 = 234.

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = 2√10, where x > 1

**Formula Used:**

(x − 1/x)² = (x + 1/x)² − 4

x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (2√10)² − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 4 × 10 − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 40 − 4 = 36

⇒ Since x > 1, x − 1/x will be positive. So, x − 1/x = √36 = 6

⇒ Now, substitute this into the cube formula:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (6)³ + 3 × 6

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 216 + 18

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 234

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Rule

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2.

Cube Rule (Plus)

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a.

Sign Conversion Rule

If x + 1/x = a, then x − 1/x = √(a² − 4). Similarly, if x − 1/x = a, then x + 1/x = √(a² + 4).
